Copyright (c) 2026, Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH

The VST3 SDK is a developer dependency used by the optional isolated scanner
helper. It is not downloaded by normal My DAW builds. When that helper is
included in My DAW.app, this notice is copied to
Contents/Resources/ThirdPartyNotices/VST3-SDK.txt.
